methoprene and the pyriproxyfen reduced the emergence of Pseudacteon flies, which are parasitic to the red imported fire ant, by approximately 30 and 60%, respectively.
exposure of fire ants parasitized with Pseudacteon larvae to methoprene or pyriproxyfen resulted in significantly fewer phorid flies than the control.
methoprene and the insect growth regulator pyriproxyfen are toxic to the endoparasitoid fly, P. tricuspis.
